note: Local originals are expected to match these live files by filename. Run scripts/audit-images.mjs to confirm dimensions, EXIF orientation and duplicates; replace any fields marked unknown.

images.observed: Group of about 20 people outside the restaurant with the mayor in regalia (opening day, shop front visible). Includes a child and members of the public. Wide collage on a black field.
images.rights: Identifiable people incl. a child; needs consent. Do not use on the site unless the owners confirm.
images.use: Our story page only, if consent is confirmed. Prefer the original photograph, not this banner.

images.observed: Three-panel collage: the owners and team outside the restaurant holding a certificate; award night with a trophy and certificate; further certificate presentation.
images.rights: Owners and guests identifiable; confirm consent.
images.use: Our story: crop one panel (award night) or request originals.

images.observed: Two panels: award group photo with certificate; owner interviewed with microphone and certificate. The right panel carries a faint agency or media watermark.
images.rights: Right panel has a visible watermark: do not use without a licence. Left panel: confirm consent.
images.use: Our story, left panel only, if consent confirmed. Exclude the watermarked panel.

images.observed: Four panels: the owner in mayoral robes; couple with a certificate; the mayor and mayoress at a monument; a robed figure outside a building.
images.rights: Identifiable people; confirm consent. Supports the press headline about the former mayor and mayoress.
images.use: Our story, one panel, if the owners want it.

images.observed: Dining room, tables laid with green napkins, Christmas garlands at the windows and crackers on tables. Wall art and green banquettes visible. WhatsApp-compressed.
images.use: Seasonal. Replace with a year-round room photograph. Interim fallback only.

images.observed: Shop front at night with the MALDON SPICE sign, Christmas window decoration and a neighbouring hair salon's sign at right. Useful for 'find us' recognition.
images.use: Visit page, interim (until a daytime exterior is shot). Decorations date it to Christmas.
images.alt: The Maldon Spice shop front on the High Street at night

images.observed: Table detail: green napkin in a steel ring, glasses, cutlery, candle, patterned wall tile and teal light behind. Good depth and colour.
images.use: Home photo pair (dining room slot) or Our story portrait. Best interior image of the set.
images.alt: A laid table in the dining room: green napkin in a steel ring, glasses, cutlery and a candle

images.observed: Top-down table setting: green napkin in a ring on a white plate, cutlery, glasses, salt and pepper mills.
images.use: Secondary portrait (Menu page header or Allergens page).

images.observed: Bar with teal LED edge lighting, bottle shelves and hanging glasses. Slightly cluttered counter. The teal cast is off-palette.
images.use: Drinks page header, if cropped tight. Otherwise skip.

images.observed: Top-down mixed grill on a long white plate: samosa, tandoori pieces, king prawns, onion bhaji and a radish rose. Strong colour, white cloth.
images.use: Home 'Our story' portrait or clay-oven slot. Best food photo of the three. Phone quality; soft when large.
images.alt: Mixed grill on a long white plate: samosa, tandoori chicken, king prawns and onion bhaji

images.observed: Two dishes (a dark chopped dish with a radish rose, a creamy yellow curry) on a table with a candle, cutlery and a cluttered edge.
images.use: Not recommended: busy edges and awkward crop.

images.observed: Chicken and peppers dish on a long white plate with roasted red pepper halves; clean white background.
images.use: Menu extract or Grills section header. Usable but flat lighting.
images.alt: Chicken with roasted red peppers on a long white plate

images.observed: Arched plate: white botanical circle (rosemary, garlic, star anise, chilli, cinnamon, bay) above MALDON SPICE, white artwork on blue-grey. The PNG has a white margin around the arch rather than transparency.
images.use: Source for the favicon and hero mark. Vectorise or request source files; remove the white margin.

images.observed: Same arched logo, 796x1024, white margin.
images.use: Fallback raster of the arched logo.

images.observed: Horizontal lockup: botanical circle left, MALDON in bold caps and Spice in a serif beneath, white on blue-grey; a white corner shows at the left edge.
images.use: Header lockup if legible at 40px height; otherwise typeset wordmark in header.

images.observed: Cropped horizontal lockup (used as the live site's header logo).
images.use: Alternative to the above.
